meta.description: Partial, manually-curated reference for Indonesia sharia stock status. This is NOT a complete Daftar Efek Syariah (DES) — it prioritises JII constituents and a few confirmed removals from public coverage of BEI's periodic index evaluation. Anything not listed here returns 'unknown', not 'non-syariah'.
meta.jii_reference: Konstituen JII periode 2 Juni – 30 November 2026 (30 ticker likuid)
meta.how_to_update: Download DES terbaru dari OJK (diterbitkan Mei & November) atau daftar konstituen JII/JII70/ISSI dari IDX, lalu tambahkan simbol ke array 'confirmed_syariah' atau 'confirmed_removed' di bawah. Ticker tanpa suffix .JK. Update meta.as_of / effective_period / ojk_decision setiap review.
